metadata.name: mastra
metadata.description: Mastra is the modern TypeScript framework for AI-powered applications and agents.

summary.zh: Mastra 是一个基于 TypeScript 的现代 AI 应用与智能体开发框架。它提供统一模型路由（支持40+模型供应商）、自主智能体、可视化工作流引擎、人机协同、上下文管理、MCP 服务端支持，以及内置评估与可观测性，帮助开发者从原型快速构建到生产级 AI 应用，并能无缝集成 React、Next.js 和 Node.js 等生态。
summary.en: Mastra is a modern TypeScript framework for building AI-powered applications and agents. It offers a unified interface to 40+ LLM providers, autonomous agents, a graph-based workflow engine, human-in-the-loop support, context management, MCP server authoring, and built-in evals and observability—enabling developers to go from prototype to production reliably and integrate with React, Next.js, and Node.js.

metadata.name: ai-agents-from-zero
metadata.description: 🚀 2026 最系统的 AI Agent 速成指南｜智能体实战教程 · 完整学习路径  + 实战项目 + 面试题库 · 对标大模型应用开发工程师岗位 · 覆盖LangChain / LangGraph / Coze / Dify / MCP / skills / LLM / RAG / 提示词 · 企业级部署与微调 · 从0到企业级落地 + 从学习到上线项目 + 面试准备一体化

summary.zh: 这个仓库是一套系统的AI Agent实战教程，从零基础到企业级落地，覆盖LangChain、LangGraph、Coze、Dify、MCP、RAG等技术，包含完整学习路径、可运行源码、实战项目和面试题库，对标大模型应用开发工程师岗位，适合系统学习。
summary.en: This repository is a systematic AI Agent practical tutorial from zero to enterprise-level deployment, covering LangChain, LangGraph, Coze, Dify, MCP, RAG, and more. It includes a complete learning path, runnable source code, practical projects, and interview question bank, targeting LLM application development engineer roles.

metadata.name: agent-study
metadata.description: 36章AI Agent全栈课程：从ReAct循环到Claude Code逆向、MCP/A2A协议、RAG、DSPy、生产可观测性——全部为可运行Python文件，面试导向。

summary.zh: 这是一套面向求职的AI Agent全栈学习课程，共36章，系统讲解从ReAct循环等基础理论到Claude Code逆向、MCP/A2A协议、RAG、DSPy及生产可观测性等前沿实践。全课程包含22000+行代码和60+个可独立运行的Python示例，按7个层次递进，适合应届生、转行者及开发者系统掌握AI Agent。
summary.en: A 36-chapter full-stack AI Agent course designed for job interviews, systematically covering core theories and engineering practices from ReAct loops to Claude Code reverse engineering, MCP/A2A protocols, RAG, DSPy, and production observability. With 22,000+ lines of code and 60+ runnable Python examples across 7 progressive levels, it suits graduates, career changers, and developers.

metadata.name: Kun
metadata.description: Local-first AI agent workspace for coding, writing, design, research, and automation — one runtime for desktop GUI and TUI.

summary.zh: Kun 是一个本地优先的 AI Agent 工作台，通过共享运行时统一桌面 GUI 与终端 TUI。它支持代码、写作、设计、研究和自动化场景，提供从需求澄清、计划执行到审查交付的完整工作流。亮点包括多模型接入、Agent Graph 分工、自动化调度及跨平台支持，数据默认保存在本机。
summary.en: Kun is a local-first AI agent workspace that unifies desktop GUI and terminal TUI on a shared runtime. It covers coding, writing, design, research, and automation, delivering an end-to-end workflow from requirement clarification to review and delivery. Highlights include multi-model support, Agent Graph orchestration, automation scheduling, cross-platform availability, and local-first data storage.

summary.zh: Vibe-Trading是由HKUDS开发的开源个人交易代理，通过单条命令赋予智能体全面的交易能力。它集成了多种交易平台接口，支持自动化交易、策略回测、影子账户等功能，采用Python、FastAPI和React构建，提供API和MCP支持，适合量化交易与个人投资者。
summary.en: Vibe-Trading is an open-source personal trading agent from HKUDS that empowers agents with comprehensive trading capabilities via a single command. It integrates multiple trading platform interfaces, supports automated trading, strategy backtesting, and shadow accounts, built with Python, FastAPI, and React, offering API and MCP support for quantitative trading and individual investors.
